verdict.rationale: Angular Signals (angular-docs-1) provide reactive state that is plain TypeScript/JS objects, which can conceptually be unit tested without rendering, and community mentions reference Angular's testability emphasis (angular-comm-8, angular-comm-10) via tools like Karma. However, no evidence pack item directly documents unit testing signals/services in isolation without TestBed/DOM rendering. missing for 10: explicit docs or examples showing signal/service unit tests without TestBed or component rendering, dedicated testing-utilities documentation, and independent hands-on confirmation of DOM-free reactive testing.
